column3: Moves the start from 0x101718. That function zeroes a 0x1C-byte object whose fields (+0x00..+0x18) are the heap object bed/bedmemory works on (0x100354 initialises the same fields) and is only called from a static initialiser, on the global heap later passed to bedmemory's allocator 0x100C84: it is bedmemory's heap constructor. 0x101738 is BedPfh::clear, called by 0x101750 (the first function with bed/bedpfh asserts) and by every BedPfh user right before it.
Engine graphics library (C): I3D_BIN/I3D_I3M/I3D_I3C format IDs in its .rodata; called from dog/, mag/, effects and menus. Every function is 8-aligned (built with other flags than the game).
Sound library: from here on callers are snd/ and game/ (sound manager); 0x237D00 is the first function calling into this region, the ones before it are called by i3d.
